provenance.scope: Installed native Bend CLI to C to Clang-O2 versus experimental native Bend frontend to QBE/binutils, both prepared Base, same zero-argument main. No object caches, every object rebuilt. Finite source-to-executable/result comparison, not compiler-wide qualification or a universal speedup.
provenance.clockScope: Primary source-to-executable seconds sum complete compiler subprocess walls; source-to-result adds program process wall. Full supervisor interval also retained. Native driver wall includes Python startup/authentication and cache-capable orchestration with object cache disabled; installed Bend authenticates its assets internally. One-time tool/version/input audit is excluded from paired measurements.
